name: STIHL MS 211 / MS 211 C-BE
blurb: 12″, 14″ and 16″ bars on 3/8″ PICCO chain, .050″ gauge, 44, 50 and 55 drive links (63 PM3), per STIHL's 2025 chain chart.
intro: The MS 211 and MS 211 C-BE are STIHL's common homeowner saws above the MS 170. STIHL's 2025 chain chart lists them with the MS 151 T C-E, MSE 170 C-B and MSE 210 C-B: 3/8″ PICCO chain, .050″ gauge, 44 drive links on 12″, 50 on 14″ and 55 on 16″ (63 PM3). The 14″ length is listed twice, once on a Rollomatic bar and once on a lightweight bar, with the same 50-link loop. The 2025 chart prints these saws as one block with the same chain rows.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PM3 44 with recommended bar 3005 000 4805. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 4.0 mm (5/32″) file for 3/8″ PICCO.
STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PM3 50 with recommended bar 3005 000 4809. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 4.0 mm (5/32″) file for 3/8″ PICCO.
bars.label: 14″ (Rollomatic)

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PM3 50 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7409. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 4.0 mm (5/32″) file for 3/8″ PICCO.
bars.label: 14″ (lightweight)

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PM3 55 with recommended bar 3005 008 4813. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 4.0 mm (5/32″) file for 3/8″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: Saw Chain Selection and Identification (catalog pages 166–167), including the file table and the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, Saw Chain Selection and Identification (catalog pp. 166–167), read 5 Nov 2026. File size from that catalog's file table (4.0 mm / 5/32″ for 3/8″ PICCO).
